text:
Andrea M: Canary finished for prefetch ring + fusion patch in us-west-2. Summary: p95 -32%, p50 -14%, throughput +12%, est infra cost /1M tokens -21%. :tada:
Sam R: awesome. which benchmark?
Andrea M: Mixed-chat harness (60% short ~40t, 40% long ~800t), 2h steady-state. p95 210ms -> 143ms, tokens/sec 9.8k -> 11.0k.
Olivia: any errors or regressions?
Andrea M: No sustained 5xx; one node had a +0.02% blip during warmup. No user retries.
Nate: What changed under the hood?
Andrea M: Replaced global prefetch mutex with per-shard lockless ring buffer + small fusion pass that combines compatible adjacent prefetches. Reduces head-of-line blocking and smooths kernel utilization.
Lisa: Memory/KV impact?
Andrea M: KV resident +4% during warmup, evictions steady at SS. Worker memory +~1.8MB.
Jordi: Rollout plan?
Andrea M: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 24h with automated gates. Canary ran 10% for 2h, then 30% 2h. Rollback if p95 >5% regression or 5xx >0.5% for 5m.
Sam R: link to dashboard/artifacts?
Andrea M: Dash: https://dash.redwood/internal/runs/4167829001. Artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/prefetch-ring/4167829001.zip
deploy-bot: deploy started 2026-03-23T12:34:10Z for canary slice (3 nodes).
ops-bot: alerting on p95, 5xx, cpu%. Auto-rollout paused until human ack.
Olivia: Long-seq tail?
Andrea M: Long-seq p95 improved ~12%, benefit concentrated on short/medium sequences.
Nate: smoke curl?
Andrea M: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-internal/canary/generation -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-compact-v2","prompt":"summarize: time series","max_tokens":200}'
Lisa: I'll co-author the runbook with Andrea.
Andrea M: Next: if 60% stage stable schedule 24h full rollout. Perf team to add runbook. Eng-SRE to watch KV eviction alerts for 48h.
Jordi: Congrats team, post a short blurb in #announcements after 100% roll. :rocket:
Sam R: :thumbsup:
Olivia: LGTM
Nate: Nice win.
Andrea M: Thanks — ping me for traces or artifacts.
